entries.name: motionsites-web-builder
entries.description: Free MIT Claude skill by MotionSites: Claude studies the most-liked designs, picks real cinematic media (50+ hero videos, 30 transparent 3D cut-outs, 40 example prompts, 55+ technique recipes), writes a build spec, builds, then screenshots its own page and fixes it until it clears a gallery-level bar. Works in Claude.ai Skills and Claude Code.
entries.install_method: Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add Motionsites-AI/claude-skill; /plugin install motionsites-web-builder@motionsites. Claude.ai/desktop: upload motionsites-web-builder.zip from the upstream latest release via Customize > Skills. Optional: pip install playwright && python -m playwright install chromium
entries.verification: Verified exact public match: upstream README is titled 'MotionSites Web Builder: a free Claude skill' and its SKILL.md name is motionsites-web-builder, matching the reel's content. The reel's DM payload is unverified (gated behind a SITE comment, never posted on Kushal's behalf) and unnecessary - the skill is public on GitHub.
entries.removal: Delete installed/motionsites-web-builder/ and remove this entry from registry.json and REGISTRY.md, then append a removal event to history.jsonl.

entries.name: Anatomy
entries.description: Claude Code skill that explains a technical idea by building it as a real working object: name an idea in one line and Claude invents a machine that does it, drawn as a live interactive isometric figure (SVG/WebGL) whose numbers come from the same model that moves its parts. Also runs in OpenCode and Codex.
entries.install_method: npx skills add wheresryan22/anatomy -g -a claude-code; then /anatomy explain how <idea> works, interactive
entries.verification: Exact public match: the reel's comment word is 'Anatomy' and the skill's own page (skills.wheresryan.sh/anatomy) matches the reel's claim; upstream SKILL.md copied verbatim. The reel's DM payload itself is unverified (no comment posted).

entries.name: REA — Reverse Engineer Anything
entries.description: MCP server + CLI that lets a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) look inside an app you do not have source for and explain how a feature works, down to the binary level, then rebuild your own version. Uses Ghidra/Hopper/IDA for native apps and built-in analysis for JS/Electron/.NET/Android/web.
entries.install_method: npx rea-agents setup (Node.js + npm required; adds REA's MCP server to chosen agents, restart after)
entries.verification: Strong public function match: caption describes pointing a coding agent at any app to learn how it works inside and rebuild liked features without stealing source; REA matches exactly and was GitHub #1 trending in Oct 2026. Reel cites ~70,000 stars; Oct 2026 coverage reported REA past 109,000 by Oct 12. The reel's DM payload itself is unverified (no comment posted).

entries.name: Prompt Master
entries.description: Claude skill that fixes your prompt before Claude answers: hand it one messy sentence and it returns a finished prompt specifying the output, what files Claude may touch, and when to stop. Audits against 35 credit-wasting patterns and remembers decisions you have already locked (stack, conventions) so Claude does not contradict them mid-chat. Profiles for 30+ AI tools.
entries.install_method: Download the repo ZIP from GitHub, then Claude > Customize > Skills > Upload; or clone into ~/.claude/skills. Then type /prompt-master before a request.
entries.verification: Exact public match: reel states the name Prompt Master, 11,000 GitHub stars, 35 credit-wasting patterns, upload via Customize > Skills, and decision memory — all confirmed in the project's own setup guide and repo (nidhinjs/prompt-master, MIT). Upstream SKILL.md copied verbatim. The reel's DM payload itself is not involved (no gate used).
entries.removal: Delete installed/prompt-master/ and remove this entry from registry.json and REGISTRY.md, then append a removal event to history.jsonl.

entries.name: Find Skills
entries.description: Discovery skill by Vercel Labs: when you ask how to do X or whether a skill exists for X, it searches the open agent-skills registry (skills.sh), ranks results by install counts and source reputation, and installs the proven SKILL.md package instead of letting the agent improvise. The most-installed agent skill in the ecosystem.
entries.install_method: npx skills add https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills --skill find-skills — then just ask Claude for a capability; it wakes up on its own.
entries.verification: Probable public match: the reel's caption does not name the skill ('Claude has a skill that helps you find the RIGHT Claude skill for almost anything'); find-skills by vercel-labs is the canonical skill with exactly that function and the ecosystem's #1 install count. Upstream SKILL.md copied verbatim. Recorded as a function match, not a name match.
